data.title: Technology — Beginner · Lesson 2
data.subject: technology
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Just moved in next door.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
New neighbors, let's explore.
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
Come and meet them with me.

[Verse]
Walking over, feeling shy,
but I give it a try.
The password… La contraseña
To unlock the day.
The camera… La cámara
Captures smiles on our way.
They say, "Welcome… Bienvenidos"
With a wave and a grin.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
New neighbors, let's explore.
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
Come and meet them with me.

[Verse]
The app… La aplicación
Helps us chat and see.
The phone… El teléfono
Rings with a melody.
The computer… La computadora
Shows a map of the street.
We laugh and we talk,
making memories so sweet.

[Bridge]
As the sun sets low,
we share stories, letting go.
In this moment, we know,
friendship starts to grow.
Technology brings us near,
breaking the ice, no fear.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
New neighbors, let's explore.
